_note: Per-query-averaged precision-recall for the test queries: each query contributes one average precision (AP) and one interpolated PR curve, weighted equally. 'aupr' is the mean AP; 'precision' is the mean interpolated curve on the 'recall' grid. Family: TP = same Rfam family, neutral = same clan, other family. Clan: TP = same clan, other family, neutral = same family. Unlabelled targets are neutral. Unretrieved relevant targets remain false negatives. Seeded methods: per-query AP and curve averaged over seeds.
